reason: The premise that W38Ta36Cr15V11 forms Cr/V-rich precipitates is directly supported by E2. The premise that Hf can suppress precipitates and defects is supported by E2's report on W29Ta42Cr5V16Hf8, though the mechanism of Hf acting as a solute/defect trap is not directly evidenced in the cited passages. The premise that minor Hf preserves manufacturability is not addressed in any cited evidence. Overall, key premises are partially supported with notable gaps.
premises: Nanocrystalline W38Ta36Cr15V11 forms Cr/V-rich precipitates under irradiation near 8 dpa
Hf doping can suppress precipitate formation by trapping solutes and defects
W29Ta42Cr5V16Hf8 showed no dislocation loops or precipitates at 10 dpa
Minor Hf addition preserves bulk manufacturability of the alloy
Suppressing precipitates maintains low hardening and high radiation resistance
